name: Chocolate Christmas Coins
subtitle: Simple chocolate rounds with white-chocolate icing and cherry decorations
description: Make small chocolate rounds, top them with white chocolate, and finish with cherry pieces or sprinkles for a festive treat.

ingredients.item: dark chocolate (or milk if you prefer)
glacé cherries cut into small pieces (or use festive sprinkles)

instructions.text: Line a tray with baking paper. Melt the dark chocolate and white chocolate separately in heatproof bowls over simmering water, or microwave them in short bursts, stirring until smooth.
Spoon the dark chocolate into 12 small rounds on the tray. Let them cool until thick but still workable.
Add a small spoonful of white chocolate to each round. Use the cocktail stick to shape or swirl the topping, then decorate with the cherry pieces or festive sprinkles.
Cool until set, then transfer the chocolate coins to a serving container.
